name: Opening range breakout
description: Trade the break of the first N minutes' range of the session, in the direction of the break.
markets: Index futures (ES, NQ), liquid US stocks, DAX

plan.summary: The opening range captures the overnight imbalance; a decisive break often runs.
plan.bias: Optional: pre-market trend or gap direction.
plan.setup: Mark the high/low of the first 15 (or 30) minutes.
plan.entry: A candle closes outside the range with above-average volume.
plan.stop: Middle or opposite side of the opening range.
plan.management: Exit by the end of the session; no overnight holds.
plan.no_trade: Range wider than 1.5× average; major news in the first hour.

fields.label: Volume above average on the break
fields.guide: Compare the break candle's volume with the 20-bar average.

rules.text: Candle closed outside the range (not just a wick)
Only the first break of the session
